# Claude Scholar for TRASH

Source: https://github.com/Galaxy-Dawn/claude-scholar
Upstream branch: `codex`
Pinned commit: `b672e80951a2348dd6136316d096603bf2dc5b83`
License: MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

This import contains Markdown instructions, references and examples for
`paper-self-review`, `citation-verification` and `review-response`. The
review-response read order uses the current TRASH project's material and does
not load the upstream optional global writing memory. Trailing whitespace was
normalized. Upstream executables, installer, agent configurations and integrations
are outside the import scope. Citation verification uses the available project
evidence and canonical sources and labels missing evidence as unverified.
